summary: Tested the new Duplicate action for content items on CoinQuest K-5. Backend (3/3 pytest cases) and frontend (Duplicate button + pre-filled Edit dialog + toast) all pass. Cleanup verified: topic_80e910ce6a69 returned to original 15 items, 0 '(Copy)' items remaining.

issues: React console warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' (BrowserRouter <- ContentManagement). Non-blocking, but should be cleaned up — likely setSearchParams called during render.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate the 'setState during render' warning in ContentManagement — non-functional but noisy in console.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend admin_duplicate_item deep-copies original including created_at then overwrites (good). Note: it does not reset content_id inside content_data — verified content_data is same reference, which is intentional per the spec (uploaded file references are shared).

Frontend duplicateContent handles success/error with toast, but on backend failure the user sees a generic 'Failed to duplicate content' with no detail — consider surfacing error.response.data.detail.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Created 2 duplicates during backend tests and 1 during frontend test; all cleaned up via DELETE /api/admin/content/items/{id}. Verified final count of topic_80e910ce6a69 = 15 with 0 '(Copy)' items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Duplicate endpoint POST /api/admin/content/items/{id}/duplicate returns {content_id,item}. Fields in item: thumbnail (not thumbnail_url), title, min_grade, max_grade, content_data, visible_to, topic_id, is_published, is_mandatory. No GET single-item admin endpoint — use list ?topic_id=... and filter. Parent topic of subtopic topic_80e910ce6a69 (Indian Rupee) is topic_54162f26e2db (Using Our Money). URL params ?topic=&subtopic= work for pre-selection on /admin/content.
